scientific_integrity: All 416 triples and minimality of the ten-factor testing basis follow from complete finite enumeration, signature-class counting, independent factor-ID replay, and ten explicit exclusive invalid witnesses; no finite test is used to assert an infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification for the tenth Tribonacci iterate only; the ten-factor basis is optimal only for testing three-position candidates. No general infinite-stage enumeration is asserted. Prior priority may be incomplete.
title: Four-box classification and a ten-factor test for the tenth Tribonacci word
